subject: Leadership handoff: role clarity & Q1 OKR pulse (draft)
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: HR Ops <hr-ops@peoplestrategies.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jan 2028 08:21:00 -0000
Subject: Leadership handoff: role clarity & Q1 OKR pulse (draft)

Team —

Quick draft below. I want to get alignment on a lightweight leadership handoff we can announce during the Q1 cadence (target: Jan 16 town hall). The goal: clarify ownership for four recurring responsibilities so product and infra teams have a single go-to for OKR decisions and cross-functional requests. This is not a reorg of headcount; primarily role clarity and temporary rotation of on-call ownership for two months while hiring completes.

Proposal (bullet summary):
- Ownership buckets
  - Platform reliability & infra roadmap: Vivek (owner)
  - Model onboarding & performance gates: Laura (owner)
  - Customer escalations & SLAs: Monica (owner)
  - Cost optimization & batching experiments: Sergio (owner)
- Timeline: Jan 16 announcement, Feb 1 operational handoff, Mar 31 review
- OKR pulse items to call out in town hall: latency SLOs, Dedicated utilization target, two model-onboarding milestones
- Communication plan: internal announcement + team-level office hours next week

Ask: please review and reply with edits by EOD Wednesday (Jan 11). Laura/Vivek — any immediate conflicts with current commitments? Monica — can you confirm support from CS for the escalation playbook? HR — can you prepare the short FAQ (2 Qs) for the town hall?

Attachments: Q1-OKR-pulse-notes-v1.docx (draft talking points)

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Sales & GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Jan 2028 12:07:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Leadership handoff: role clarity & Q1 OKR pulse (draft)

Sergio —

Thanks for the clear draft. Inline suggestions below.

> - Platform reliability & infra roadmap: Vivek (owner)
- can we make this "Infra roadmap + SLOs (Vivek, with Alice Reed as deputy)"? Adds a named deputy to avoid single point of failure.

> - Model onboarding & performance gates: Laura (owner)
- happy to own. Recommend we split onboarding into "new-model intake" and "production validation" so we can measure cycle time. I'll add a metric: % models passing acceptance within 10 business days.

> - Customer escalations & SLAs: Monica (owner)
- Monica — can your team commit to the weekly escalation readout for the first two months? If not, we should identify CS lead.

> - Cost optimization & batching experiments: Sergio (owner)
- Suggest adding a "runbook for rollback" item — to be comfortable with live experiments.

I also added two suggested slides to the Drive doc: ownership map and a one-pager FAQ. No major conflicts on my side.

Onwards,
Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Sergio / all —

Appreciate the concise plan. Two quick flags from infra:
1) Hiring: the infra staff we expect to onboard won't be fully productive until mid-Feb. If we make Vivek sole owner for roadmap decisions in Jan, I need a deputy who can make SLA tradeoffs in real time. Laura's deputy suggestion works; I'd propose Alice Reed or Markus Klein as deputy and decision delegate.
2) SLOs: the latency SLO callout is good; add a note that the SLO measurement window for Q1 will be 30-day rolling to avoid noisy weekly variance.

Otherwise minor edits. I can take ownership of the roadmap items and the SLO measurement approach, with the deputy named before Jan 16.

-Vivek
